name: TEP++ Farsi SMT Benchmark
description: Measures statistical machine translation performance for Farsi using the TEP++ corpus as the evaluation dataset.
reputation: A niche, domain-specific benchmark primarily used by researchers working on Persian/Farsi machine translation; modest adoption outside that community.
notes: Designed for statistical machine translation of Farsi; dataset size and age make it small by modern NMT/LLM standards. Results can be influenced by training-data contamination from parallel corpora; benchmark is SMT-focused and may be saturated or outperformed by modern NMT/LLM approaches.
